transcript: My name is Sashini Pereira, and I am a recent computing graduate preparing for a QA engineer role. My background includes hands-on work with Selenium, Postman, and Gira, mainly through academic projects, individual practice, and collaborative assignments. One area I enjoy most is improving software quality through structured testing. For example, I contributed to a expense tracking application in the Finance domain, where I learned how to plan tasks, communicate with teammates, and deliver features with clear ownership. I am applying for this role because I want to strengthen my technical foundation in a real production environment, and grow into a professional who combines problem solving with consistent execution. At the same time, I am actively working on answering under pressure so I can present my ideas more effectively in professional discussions. A project I am proud of is the expense tracking application, which was created for the Finance domain. I worked in a team of four, and my main contribution was to develop reporting features and categorized transaction data. We use Selenium, Postman, and Gira to build and validate the solution. One of the main challenges was unclear transaction categories. To address it, I broke the issue into smaller parts, discussed possible solutions with the team, and tested the final approach before completing the integration. The project was valuable because it improved my technical understanding and taught me how to communicate progress clearly under deadlines. As a result, the final system helped users understand spending patterns more clearly.
